string.name: custom_receipt_provider_timeout_note
string.comment: Location: Explanatory text. Purpose: Note explaining the timeout behavior of the custom receipt provider.

resources.string:
Note: For custom receipt printing, Clover has fixed timeout set in place for provider's response. If provider doesn't respond within that timeout, Clover will reject print request and show "Print Failed" toast message.
This behavior can be tested using timeout options: 
 ● Timeout Uris: It will force provider to respond with list of uris after the timeout. 
 ● Timeout Bitmaps: It will force provider to respond with receipt bitmap(s) after the timeout. 
 ● Test without Timeout: Provider will respond normally without any timeout.
